text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san, happy birthday! ...Wait, is 
something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I really thought that once my birthday 
came, I might finally be able to use some 
magic, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In the end, you can't summon lightning, 
make it rain, or fly through the sky after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on! When am I finally gonna become a 
witch?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Then, how about I lift you up, Sweep-san, 
and make it look like you're flying 
through the sky?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's just a regular piggyback lift! 
That's not magic at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, it looks kind of fun, so I 
suppose I could let you try it!"
